query: I think there’s a disaster movie where a tunnel under the river collapses after a truck explodes, and a guy with a flashlight tries to lead people out through flooded passages.
Telugu revenge thriller where a London businessman’s youngest son sets out to ruin a rival in thirty days by charming his daughter, while their dad is seriously ill.
Looking for an old flick where a madman escapes an asylum in South Africa, gets a blood transfusion from an invisibility experiment, then goes after a wealthy family.
I think there was a 1940s romance where a newspaper reporter from New York meets a leprechaun and a mysterious Irish girl on a trip, then has to pick between her and his rich fiancée’s world.
What’s that indie comedy-drama where a grown man with a kid’s mindset invites his childhood friend to his mom’s funeral and then trails him around Los Angeles, writing a play about him?
Hazy memory of a horror movie set in a small town where a creepy clown lives in the sewers and wakes every few decades to hunt kids, and a group of preteen friends fights back.
A 1960s superhero flick where young mutants team up against a villain who wants missiles set up in Cuba to spark a global war, with a telepath and a guy who controls metal.
I think there’s an old Tamil film set near Chennai about a sage tempted by a celestial woman sent by a god, and a baby is tossed into bushes then rescued.

British period drama from the 1930s in France where a live-in maid’s younger sister joins the household, and their jealousy and secret relationship spiral into something dark with their wealthy employer.
Old Tamil movie about a naive young villager who runs off to Madras, works as a hotel room boy, falls for a prostitute, and ends up sick in a hospital bed.
Old cartoon where a hunter must leave animals alone to inherit money, so the rabbit he’s chasing moves into his house and torments him, ending with a giant Easter egg full of bunnies.
Gritty 70s film about a college English professor with a gambling habit who borrows from loan sharks, ends up in Las Vegas, and eventually gets cut across the face in a brawl.
Hong Kong action flick where a cop goes rogue to avenge a dead colleague, teams up with a timid officer and a drug-addicted informant, and kidnaps a dealer at the airport.
Anime set in an alternate World War II where girls with magic powers who sprout animal ears and tails fly into battle against mysterious alien aircraft spreading corrosive mist.
Tamil romance where a poor college singer falls for a rich girl just from her phone calls, then wants to see her in person.
Bollywood thriller set in a Goa mansion where a rich woman’s kidnapped son turns up with a broke actor and his girlfriend, and then the woman is found dead in a suitcase.
Fuzzy memory of a 90s sci-fi where a Detroit teen who sells stolen goods gets knocked down by a vehicle and wakes up as a slave on a South Carolina plantation in the 1800s next to a huge tree.
Old drama about a plane losing two engines flying out of Portugal toward America, where a stressed pilot must ditch in the ocean and a kid’s dog rides in the cargo hold.
Old Telugu drama about a father who tosses away his baby son for inheritance, the boy grows up to be a rebel gangster, and then falls for a dancer.

Some Bollywood movie where an orphan boy gets wrongly jailed for a murder, comes out years later to find his school turned into a gambling den, and then hunts down the real killer who’s now running for office.
Old British comedy about a racing stable sending a scrappy substitute horse across the Channel to Paris, where two crooks try hiding fake banknotes in its blanket.
A 1930s American comedy where a fired newspaperman and his buddy set up shop on a park bench and he becomes a radio star with folksy sayings, until a brick during a brawl.
Old cartoon about a ghost who reads a friend-making self-help book and tries to befriend the living, but a mole runs off and a train fails to end his afterlife.
Silent-era mystery where a jeweled garter vanishes from a London museum, a thief who loves leaving clues gets blamed, and a rich girl is pulled from the sea by a yachtsman.
Old Hindi film where a man is wrongly convicted of murder, his pregnant wife nearly drowns herself and gets taken in by a village, and their grown son turns to crime. A jobless detective wanders in.
Classic Hollywood musical set in a rowdy 1900s nightclub district where a saloon owner falls for a singer, and the film ends with a huge earthquake and fire flattening the city.
Crime flick where a drug kingpin fresh out of prison rides into town in a limo, wants to run for mayor, and ends up in a gunfight on a subway car with a cop.
Turkish comedy-drama about a dreamer trying to get his first movie made, stuck waiting on a letter from a stubborn censorship official who enforces a pointless rule.
Drama about a nine-year-old girl with a tic disorder who finds her confidence in a school production of Alice, while her mom refuses to accept there’s anything wrong.
Seventies war film about a plane hijacked from Athens and diverted to an African airport, where a commando team flies thousands of miles for a night rescue of the hostages.
Old British comedy where a shy, timid guy’s reflection climbs out of the mirror and starts living the wild life he’s always fantasized about.
Late forties drama about two undercover immigration agents posing as poor farmhands to stop a smuggling racket, with a memorable gunfight in a quicksand swamp.
Malayalam comedy-drama where two bickering cops escorting prisoners on a train lose one at a station, then end up hiding a killing in a church graveyard.
Tamil action flick about a forest service officer sent to a small town to take down a sadistic local tyrant, who ends up on trial after dealing with corrupt cops and a collector.
WWII-era film about a gruff blimp pilot at a New Jersey naval base who invents a son, then gets a disabled young man to pose as him and become a navy flier.
Silent western where an English gentleman takes the fall for his cousin’s embezzlement, starts a new life on a Western ranch, and marries a local woman before sending their son back to England.

Japanese live-action superhero film about five young recruits trained in martial arts and mystical aura energy to fight an underground kingdom planning to invade the upper world, with a princess spy frozen in ice.
Kannada art-house drama about a couple renting a cramped room beside a noisy motor garage, with a giant four-poster bed squeezed in and bulldozers flattening a slum near the end.
Indian crime drama about a baby left on a goods train, raised by a slum, who grows into a vigilante with a yellow shawl as his only clue to his mother, and a friendship with a local strongman.
Chinese drama spanning many years about a clerk and her factory friend who love each other but are torn apart by family pressure, with a red glove that sparks their romance and a Shanghai reunion.
Tamil comedy thriller about a young medical rep who grabs a phone left on a tea shop table, and his carefree life with his girlfriend falls apart after that.
Telugu village drama where a carefree guy gets dumped in a river by a landlord's goons and wakes up with amnesia, tutoring rich kids before his past comes back.
Malayalam crime drama set in a Kozhikode market where a fearless street boss lost a hand as a boy, protects the poor, and wipes out a gang after a bombing kills his friends.
1987 drama about two former high school buddies, a cop and a fallen academic star, whose bitter reunion turns deadly when a convenience store holdup goes wrong on Christmas Eve.
Old Looney Tunes short where Porky and Daffy try dodging a stingy hotel manager who charges for air and sunshine, and Daffy phones Bugs for escape tips.
Screwball comedy where a publicity-hungry actress gets jailed for a stunt, then sneaks into a job as a maid for a family and keeps getting dragged into fake robberies.
Canadian horror film about a group of role-playing gamers at a costume rental shop, where one player gets cursed and starts killing people, and the dungeon master turns out to be the devil.
Indie drama where a woman throws a fake birthday party that turns into an intervention for her sister, and the group's concern starts to look shaky.
Tamil drama about a gold-medal graduate with terrible luck who finally gets lucky after saving a pregnant passenger in his auto rickshaw, then marries, but happiness doesn't last.
Old thriller where a blind woman's apartment becomes a battleground when con men hunt for a doll stuffed with drugs, and she smashes every light bulb to fight them in the dark.
Tamil comedy-drama about a village guy who goes to the city hoping to be a movie star, becomes a stuntman, and marries a rich, arrogant feminist who clashes with him constantly.
Film noir where two buddies on a fishing trip in Mexico pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a psycho killer, and he forces them deep into the desert at gunpoint.
Wartime romance about a Polish pianist and pilot who loses his memory after crashing his plane during the Battle of Britain, then recalls his past while his wife plays a key role.
Action drama where a construction company owner goes undercover for the DEA to save his son from a long prison sentence by running drugs for a cartel.
Cult slasher from the 80s where a taxi driver obsessed with a horror queen follows her to the Cannes film festival, and the whole thing turns out to be a movie within the movie.
Early talkie crime drama about estranged brothers, one a tough police captain and the other a wanted crook, with a woman who betrays the criminal out of revenge.
Pre-Code drama about a father and son con team that gambles away their firm's money, with the son's ex-girlfriend's husband as the district attorney prosecuting him.
Kannada romance where a girl's father is lining up a German NRI groom, but she secretly loves the neighbour who keeps denying her feelings.

Epic drama about a boy in apartheid-era South Africa, raised by a Zulu nanny, who gets bullied at an Afrikaans boarding school, befriends a German pianist, and learns to box from a Cape Coloured inmate.
Old comedy about three young women sharing a fashionable Budapest flat, where one counts the room's corners and makes a wish for a hat shop, a rich husband, or the impossible.
Late-60s New York drama set in a downtown apartment building where a janitor tells a young woman about tenants' past romances, one of which ends with a sailor's gun and a woman reapplying her makeup.
Japanese comedy where a wandering salesman, who has never flown before, boards a plane to Okinawa after getting a letter from a lounge singer who's dying.
Film noir about a bored Texas housewife who leaves her husband after their son dies, then climbs the social ladder in a big city through a gangster's mistress role and falls for his rival.
Classic screwball comedy where a young woman pretends to be a 12-year-old to get a cheap train ticket, then ends up sharing a sleeper compartment with a military instructor.
Western-style drama set in Prohibition Kentucky where a moonshiner refuses to cut in a tax agent, so the agent brings in a violent hired gun, and the whole thing ends with buried dynamite.
Late-60s counterculture comedy-drama based on a folk song about a Massachusetts church commune, a Thanksgiving trash-dumping mishap, and a arrest that turns into a courtroom bit.
Early talkie prison comedy where two convicts help a buddy in love with a women's prison inmate, and the film climaxes with a prison baseball game.
Musical comedy where a bunch of talented friends show up at a resort expecting a job as entertainment, only to find their pal is actually stuck doing kitchen work.
Classic Indian social drama about a farmer who loses his only land to a landlord's debt scheme, then heads to Calcutta to earn money while his family suffers back home.
Tamil romance where a guy befriends a girl only to help her win the man she loves, but he's secretly in love with her all along.
Old Technicolor musical set in a Caribbean village where a dreamy girl is engaged to a pompous mayor, and a traveling performer pretends to be a legendary pirate to win her.
Wartime romance where an American conductor tours the Soviet Union, falls for a local pianist, and their love story is cut short when Germany invades.
Horror film where a young American nanny in a creepy English house is told to look after a porcelain doll as if it were a real child, and the rules she's given get more and more unsettling.
Japanese horror about a group of red-robed sorcerers murdering people across a city to build a giant pentagram around a high school, while a transfer student who's a witch tries to stop them.
British period horror about a 19th-century anatomy lecturer who buys fresh corpses from two drunken killers, and a young assistant who begins to suspect the bodies are being murdered for money.
Comedy about two concert promoters who blow their budget on jewelry, then scramble to pay a rapper while a drug dealer and an angry mob chase them around California.
British political thriller where an MP who opposes American nukes gets framed by a tabloid, and a reporter digs into an air force base cover-up that gets him killed in a blast.
Tamil revenge film about a shepherd with a long ponytail who swears vengeance on the thugs who killed his parents, then shaves his hair and shows up dressed as a cowboy.
Drama about a border immigration agent in El Paso who gets pulled into a human smuggling ring by his greedy wife, and has to confront his partner after he discovers the killings.
Crime epic set in Prohibition-era Chicago where a federal agent builds a team of honest cops to bring down a notorious gangster, and the film climaxes in a shootout at a train station.
